newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco navy seizes 736 kg drug on Italian yacht.
newsitem.headline: Morocco navy seizes 736 kg drug on Italian yacht.

text.p: A Moroccan navy unit seized 736 kg (1,625 lbs) of cannabis resin from an Italian yacht after stopping it off Morocco's Mediterranean coast, the official Moroccan news agency MAP said on Wednesday.
The authorities arrested the lone yachtsman aboard the Cavallo Pazzo, and impounded the Sainto Stefano-registered vessel after the inspection on Sunday off the northern province of Tetouan.
MAP said the drug was found packaged in 20 parcels.
Morocco is spearheading a crackdown on drug smugglers with the aim of wiping out the traffic to the European market. Hundreds of foreigners had been arrested and jailed in the past few years.
